approvals.summary: Consent is valid for 'rewards-personalization'. Scope and purpose verified against customer profile.
Candidate-1 successfully balances the customer's mixed persona (PROGRESS_AND_COMMUNITY) by featuring all 4 active goals individually alongside the required gamification elements and ADD_GOAL_CARD.
No dark patterns, manipulative urgency, or hidden choices detected. Hard gates passed for candidate-1.

All mandatory components present, priority sequence is unique and ascending (1 to 9), layout spans properly configured for 2-column grid pairing on half-span cards, and all prop values populated from real intelligence profile data.
Grid layout pairings and semantic card structures adhere to accessibility standards for screen reader navigation.
All 9 checklist criteria successfully passed. Stage R validation complete, releasing candidate-1.
